name: modify_order_items
description: Change the line items on an order and adjust its stock reservations. The order must still be pending. mode selects the operation: add takes sku and quantity, remove takes sku with an optional quantity, replace takes sku and replacement_sku. Each entry in items must carry a quantity, which the server reads in every mode; where a mode does not use it, pass the line's current quantity so the entry is well formed.

mode.description: Which of add, remove or replace to apply to every entry in items.

items.description: Entries to apply. Which fields each entry needs depends on mode.

sku.description: Variant identifier. In replace mode, the line being changed.

quantity.description: Units. Required in add mode, optional in remove mode, unused in replace mode.

replacement_sku.description: The variant to swap in. Required in replace mode only.

error_returns.when: The order does not exist, or a named SKU is not on it.
mode is not add, remove or replace; items is empty; a replace entry has no replacement_sku; the quantity removed exceeds the line; or the change would leave the order empty.
An add or replace needs more units than exist.
